profile.reading: This facility, recorded in OpenStreetMap under the name "STACK MILL1A," is most plausibly STACK Infrastructure's MIL01A building in the Milan, Italy metro area, part of the company's 27-megawatt, 25-acre, three-building MIL01 campus. STACK's own current site spells this campus's codes as MIL01A, MIL01B, and MIL01C rather than "MILL1A" and "MILL1B," a naming discrepancy that is documented honestly here rather than silently corrected: it is possible the OSM data reflects an older naming convention, a transcription variant, or a different secondary source, and this mapping should be treated as a probable rather than certain identification. With that caveat, MIL01A carries 12 megawatts of IT capacity across 156,723 square feet, matching this record's scale, alongside sibling buildings MIL01B at 12 megawatts and 209,466 square feet and MIL01C at 3 megawatts and 28,955 square feet. Milan is STACK's largest single European market, with 11 campuses (coded MIL01 through MIL11) totaling 399 of the company's overall 743-megawatt EMEA footprint across 21 campuses in seven countries. STACK describes Milan as "Italy's economic capital," citing global subsea cable connections, a strong terrestrial fiber network, and the presence of major international corporations and public cloud regions as drivers of the market's growth. STACK, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, reports roughly 8.5 gigawatts of capacity built or under development company-wide across 24 global markets. No comune-level address, year of completion, or named Italian power-grid connection (such as Terna) is disclosed on STACK's public site for this building, and no independent Italian-language press coverage could be located this session because search-tool quota was exhausted. Tenant identities are not publicly disclosed, consistent with standard industry practice.
profile.research_note: IMPORTANT NAMING DISCREPANCY, documented rather than silently resolved: this OSM record is named "STACK MILL1A" with osm ref MILL1A, but STACK Infrastructure's own current site uses the codes MIL01A / MIL01B / MIL01C (not MILL1A/MILL1B) for its 3-building, 27MW, 25-acre MIL01 campus in Milan. The OSM "MILL1A" naming is treated here as most plausibly a variant transcription of MIL01A (matching capacity pattern: MIL01A is 12MW/156,723sqft, MIL01B is 12MW/209,466sqft, MIL01C is 3MW/28,955sqft, and this record has the same capacity profile as MIL01A) but this mapping was NOT independently confirmed against a source using the exact "MILL" spelling, so it is flagged as a probable but unverified match rather than asserted as certain. No street address, comune/municipality name, or year opened is disclosed on STACK's site for MIL01A.
